coroner_usage:
Coroner commands (administrators only):
/coroner — global statistics and recent errors.
/coroner help — show this help.
/coroner ref <ID> — save a live reference; run inside a moderated group.
/coroner start — verify the reference and start checks.
/coroner stop — stop checks; observation continues.
/coroner run G1|G2|G3|G4|ALL — queue checks; requires a running module.
/coroner detectors — anomaly detector statistics and thresholds.
/coroner quarantine — quarantined accounts and profile links.
/coroner review — review deletion candidates.
/coroner acknowledge — release a resolved protection incident.
Commands apply across all moderated chats. Subcommands and grades ignore case.
coroner_group_only: Use Coroner in a private chat with the bot or a moderated group or supergroup.
coroner_ref_group_only: Set the reference with /coroner ref <ID> in a moderated group where the bot can look up this account.
coroner_stopped: Coroner is stopped. Observation continues; checks require /coroner start.
coroner_error_stopped: Coroner is in error. Correct the problem and use /coroner start; stop does not clear the safety lock.
coroner_started: Coroner started in all moderated chats.
coroner_not_running: Checks are disabled. Use /coroner start first.
coroner_ref_saved: Reference account {user_id} saved with chat {chat_id}. Coroner remains stopped; use /coroner start.
coroner_ref_required: Set a live reference account with /coroner ref <ID> before starting.
coroner_start_failed: Coroner could not start. Use /coroner to view recent errors.
coroner_ref_failed: Could not save the reference account. Use /coroner to view recent errors.
coroner_reference_waiting: Waiting for a successful reference check; deletions are blocked.
coroner_removed: Removed users in the last 30 days (unique): {counts}
coroner_storage_error: Cannot read or save Coroner JSON files. Checks are stopped; repair the files or permissions and restart the bot.
coroner_config_error: Invalid Coroner configuration. Check coroner_config.json and use /coroner start again.
coroner_api_forbidden: the bot does not have access or the required permissions
coroner_api_bad_request: Telegram rejected the request; check the chat, account and bot permissions
coroner_ui_action: Try updating the status again later.
coroner_profile_unknown: The profile for user {user_id} is incomplete or contradictory. No removal was performed; the check will be retried.
coroner_invalid_participant: User {user_id} was excluded from Coroner monitoring: Telegram rejected the participant ID. Further checks for this user are disabled.
coroner_reference_failed: CRITICAL: the reference account {user_id} was detected as deleted. Coroner is in error and requires a successful manual /coroner start.
coroner_reference_unknown: The reference account could not be verified as alive. Deletions are blocked until a successful reference check.
coroner_protected_member: Cannot remove user {user_id}: the account is a chat administrator or owner. No role changes were made.
coroner_uncertain_removal: The result of an interrupted removal of user {user_id} could not be confirmed. It was not counted as a successful removal.
coroner_count_mismatch: The saved participants and Telegram member count disagree. The untracked percentage is unavailable until membership is reconciled.
coroner_worker_error: Coroner encountered an internal error. The affected check will be retried; other bot functions remain available.
coroner_safety_blocked: Automatic removals are blocked. Administrator review is required. {reason}
coroner_safety_kind_activity: A quarantined account sent a new message
coroner_safety_kind_interrupted: A removal has an uncertain result
coroner_safety_kind_budget_history: Insufficient retained history for the configured removal window
coroner_detector_current: Samples: {samples}; matches: {matches}; value: {value}{unit}; threshold: {threshold}{unit}; {progress}% of trigger threshold
coroner_detector_candidates: Currently quarantined: {count}; daily multiplier: {coefficient}; previous complete days, min / max / mean: {history}
coroner_removed_period: Removals in the last {days} days; percentages use current summed chat memberships:
coroner_review_none: No review snapshot. Create a snapshot to review the current quarantine.
coroner_review_counts: Snapshot: {users} users, {targets} chat removals. Current quarantine: {current}.
coroner_review_stale: This request is no longer valid. Open or create the current review snapshot.
coroner_review_decided: Decision saved for the snapshot. New candidates require a separate decision.
coroner_review_no_accounts: There are no accounts to confirm in this snapshot.
coroner_profile_buttons_unavailable: Telegram blocks account-link buttons for these IDs in this chat. Other account buttons remain available:
coroner_account_links_loading: Checking account links… You can still use Stop and navigation.
coroner_account_links_failed: Could not finish checking account links. Press Update to retry.
coroner_review_cannot_resume: Cannot release the safety block: quarantine is not empty or a detector is still triggered. Review candidates and resolve the cause first.
coroner_review_resumed: Safety incident acknowledged. Removal budgets were preserved; normal checks and quarantine still apply.
